$comment: Home page content. heroGallery = photographs of cultural life around the world that flow across the opening of the home page, in viewing order (assetId = CC.assets id with kind image and group home-gallery; alt text and credit live in assets.json). what = a short caption of what the photo shows (from its alt text, nothing more; shown on the first caption line). place names where the photo was taken, only as far as the file page says; never guess a country or community from appearance. These photos do not mean a country has content: only countries listed below do. countries = destinations listed under the opening. status: ready = has a country page (href). Only list a country here once it has real, sourced content: there are no placeholder countries. preview = media shown behind the list when the name is hovered or focused: imageId (required), optional videoId (landscape clips only; played only when motion is allowed and the connection is not in data-saving mode). intro is editorial: what the page covers, not a cultural claim. contexts (per country, optional) = the three places on the home contents page, in order: title and local (Vietnamese name), line (editorial: what our stories there cover, never a cultural claim), imageId + caption (where the photo really is), phraseId (one phrase used there; its status and audio label come from phrases.json), href (the theme on the country page) and sceneId (the optional practice scene).
